name: New glyphs for Shanoa: Refectio and Arma Custos
summary: Refectio, a heal-over-time glyph (package 20), and Arma Custos, a timed STR buff with Cerberus's third head above Shanoa (its glyph row lives in the Catacombs package 10).
state: Refectio: casts, heals and gains mastery in game; its optional OoE cast art not yet seen in game. Arma Custos: confirmed in game 2026-11-21 (timer, head art, status screen, Custos pair bonus).

features.runtime_switch: hod_native_mods.txt or package 20 listed in dlc_packages.txt
hod_native_mods.txt or the Catacombs package 10 listed in dlc_packages.txt

depends: catacombs (Arma Custos only: its glyph row, text, art and Cerberus boss-chest drop are built into package 10)

contents: data/item/glyphset_dlc20.dat (glyph 8, item 0x815, cloned from Luminatio; power -60 -> -150, 40 MP, Shanoa only)
data/opd/skill/rfx/p_rfx00.opd (only when built with --ooe <the player's Order of Ecclesia ROM>)
glyph 9 row (item 0x816), 80 MP, 60 s STR buff
Cerberus boss chest entry (category 9, index 9, weight 2500) in the chapter's own set files
the third head's sprite from the player's OoE ROM (rbc09), when recorded

edits_outside_package.change: Refectio (category 9, index 8) in the 5 purple chests (weight 300) and the boss chest (weight 1000), Normal and Hard
edits_outside_package.tool: refectio.py install / chests; uninstall removes them

shared_hooks: arma-custos: kSkillPreload 20, kSkillFactory 20, kPlayerUpdate 20, kOwnerDraw 30, kStatusSummary 20, kAttackValue 10

claims.glyphs: 8 Refectio (item 0x815), 9 Arma Custos (item 0x816); base glyphs 0-4, DLC 5-7

user_inputs: Optional: USA Order of Ecclesia ROM (.nds) for Refectio's cast art and Arma Custos's head; without it Refectio draws no effect
build: python mods/glyphs/tools/arma_custos.py --ooe <OoE ROM>   (optional, records the ROM for the head art)
python mods/catacombs/tools/catacombs_dlc.py build          (Arma Custos data goes into package 10)
